contract_owner: implementation/api-contracts.md and openapi.yaml are authoritative for API field/path definitions

deployment.private_storage: R2 S3 endpoint; no public custom domain/r2.dev
deployment.database: Neon Scale Singapore 0.5–2 CU; warm; autosuspend disabled

canonical_request.territory: explicit validated ISO3166-1 alpha2 uppercase catalog query; storefront context only, not rights authority
canonical_request.currency: not present in public cached representations; authenticated offers only
canonical_request.cacheable_catalog_page: unfiltered first page only; cursor/filter/search requests bypass
canonical_request.unknown_or_duplicate_query: reject400 or canonicalize with no-store redirect; never ignore parameters at CDN
canonical_request.locale_source: URL; Accept-Language and cookies never change a cached representation
canonical_request.theme_source: local CSS preference; same response bytes
canonical_request.key: https://{allowed_host}{normalized_path}?locale={locale}&territory={territory}; full URL default Cloudflare key; no custom key needed

bypass_if: response Vary contains Cookie or Authorization
untrusted forwarded host or format suffix
cache_admission.private_conditional_rule: authorization/rights/device validation precedes conditional evaluation; do not emit304 for denied access
cache_admission.public_object_rights: Only globally cleared public cover/preview objects and previews API representations; territory query is not public-object authorization. Territorial restricted samples use authorized private delivery, not shared public cache.

classes.sw: network-first; generic offline shell only; no personalized HTML

classes.scope: anonymous home/explore/title/series/track metadata and admitted first-page JSON; no entitlements/progress/prices
classes.sw: online network-first; explicitly stored metadata snapshot <=24h shown offline with last_updated_at and no access authority

classes.scope: Globally cleared for public delivery only. physically bounded text/audio preview objects only; versioned path
classes.sw: no background precache; explicit permitted preview save only; never fetch full paid object

classes.scope: Globally cleared for public delivery only: LIVE editions with current rights in EVERY active publication territory (otherwise private, no-store). Reviewed cover widths 160/320/480/800 (2:3, JPEG) on content-hashed, query-less paths /api/v1/content/covers/{asset_id}/{sha256}/w{width}.jpg; any query string or non-canonical width is 404 no-store; no arbitrary resize service; the 800x1200 original is served unchanged at w800
classes.owner_decision: 2026-11-26: public covers cached long with resized thumbnail sizes; draft/staff covers stay private no-store
classes.swr_rule: swr_seconds 0 applies to the edge and to the content-hashed rendition paths. Only the unversioned path /api/v1/content/covers/{asset_id} may send browser stale-while-revalidate=604800, and only while max-age+604800 <= remaining rights seconds (earliest rights end across active publication territories); otherwise it sends no stale-while-revalidate
classes.rights_cap: known_rights_expiry applies: every max-age is min(value, earliest rights end across active publication territories); immutable never extends past that end

headers.Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control: public, max-age={min(3600, rights seconds)}, stale-while-revalidate=0, stale-if-error=0

unversioned_path.Cache-Control: public, max-age={min(86400, rights seconds)}, stale-while-revalidate=604800 only while max-age+604800 <= rights seconds (otherwise no stale-while-revalidate)
unversioned_path.Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control: public, max-age={min(3600, rights seconds)}, stale-while-revalidate=0, stale-if-error=0

classes.purge: Each emitted anonymous public cover URL is recorded as a public cache reference (asset, revision, edition and work dependencies); publication, replacement and withdrawal purge it with its sibling widths and unversioned path. A cover response that cannot be recorded is not stored at the edge (CDN-Cache-Control: no-store). A row is written with up to 3600 s headroom beyond the edge TTL; a request whose URL, asset/revision and epoch are already covered until now+edge TTL performs no ledger write, and a 304 revalidation never writes (an unrecorded conditional request receives the full 200).
classes.private: Draft and staff covers (/api/v1/staff/draft-covers/{asset_id}, staff review covers) and any authenticated cover remain private, no-store
classes.sw: bounded public UI cache; purge locally on online withdrawal notice; already copied bytes cannot be recalled
cache-first with build manifest hashes; retain current+previous shell release only
network revalidate; activate only after compatible payload migration
network-only; explicitly authorized offline data stored separately, never generic runtime cache

classes.scope: paid Reader chunks/audio/captions/timing maps from signed S3 endpoint
classes.sw: only explicit download manager writes verified bytes under synthetic account/device keys; not signed URL key

classes.scope: provider-signed HLS/DASH; no app CDN proxy/cache
classes.headers_ref: cache_admission.private_headers applies to grant response; provider controls its own segments
classes.sw: never intercept/cache video manifest/segments/tokens in P0

cdn_configuration.format: semantic settings; convert to exact current Cloudflare API schema during provisioning
cdn_configuration.edge_ttl_override: none; do not ignore private/no-store or strip Set-Cookie
cdn_configuration.tiered_cache: optional within available plan; not required for correctness
cdn_configuration.cache_tags_prefix_purge: optional; P0 uses exact URL purge, no paid-plan dependency

request_rules_in_order.name: public build/assets allowlist
request_rules_in_order.action: eligible only for exact public prefixes and admitted MIME/response headers

request_rules_in_order.name: public anonymous catalog/editorial allowlist
request_rules_in_order.action: eligible for named SSR/API routes with exact canonical query and no cookies/auth

request_rules_in_order.name: private override last
request_rules_in_order.action: bypass all auth/me/commerce/staff/webhooks/search/grants/Reader routes and all Cookie/Authorization requests

grants.license_deadline: min(now+24h, entitlement_end, rights_end, policy_end); no recurring renewal while offline
grants.revoke_semantics: deny new grants immediately in authoritative DB; issued bearer URLs remain usable until expiry and in-flight/buffered bytes persist; disconnected copies not immediately revocable
grants.presigned_method: Signed GET supports requested Range; do not use GET signature for HEAD. HEAD separately signed only if explicitly needed; use known manifest metadata otherwise.

budgets.offline_preflight: estimate()+persist() best effort; stay below min(user limit, app ceiling, 80% available estimate); estimate not guarantee

offline.account_namespace: opaque local namespace; never authorization; never analytics identifier
offline.synthetic_route: service-worker-only; origin returns404 no-store; bypass CDN
offline.audio_piece_storage: verify Range206 bytes against publication piece hash; wrap as synthetic200; reconstruct validated single byte ranges for offline media
offline.mark_complete: all required chunks/pieces + manifest hash verified, then atomic IDB transition; never play partial chapter offline
offline.clock: record server time and monotonic anchor; suspicious rollback/unknown expired lease requires online renewal; browser is not tamperproof
offline.logout: immediately lock local account namespace, stop media, purge its IDB/cache/queues, notify tabs; server logout afterward/retry if offline
offline.device_revoke: server session+license revocation now; reachable app purges next check; offline device learns at next connection or local lease expiry
offline.overflow: coalesce unsent progress; never discard annotations silently; block new durable writes and offer local export/reconnect when bound reached
offline.quiz_offline: retain draft answers locally; create/submit idempotent attempt only online; no authoritative grade/completion offline

purge.source: transactional PostgreSQL outbox in same publish/withdraw transaction
purge.worker: existing frequent scheduled command; no Redis/queue broker
purge.scope: exact URL variants recorded with emitted references and locale/territory; remove/bypass cursor/search from CDN admission
purge.success: API acknowledgement + sampled origin/CDN readback; not claimed instantaneous global recall
purge.provider_rate_limit: respect current plan rate and Retry-After; batch30 is application bound, not quoted vendor limit
purge.idempotency: event_id and per-zone batch digest; repeat safe purge
withdraw_order: tombstone mutable origin routes; deny grants
hide public preview objects and enqueue public object URL purge
verify target URLs no longer expose withdrawn public sample

known_rights_expiry.at_zero: private,no-store or unavailable; no stale-while-revalidate or stale-if-error beyond deadline
known_rights_expiry.condition: Finite public clearance; durable prior copies cannot be recalled.
